algocraft.gui.bank_update_help.instructi:
Server bank update guide:
1. Close the IDE and open Minecraft chat.
2. Run: /algocraft bank update-official
Requires operator level 2. The server validates the bank and syncs it to every player.
To reload local bank files: /algocraft bank reload
If downloading fails, the current bank remains available.
